# Cloud Platforms

Fetch cloud platform URLs for deals, invoices, quotations and tickets.

```php
Teamleader::cloudPlatforms()
```

| | |
|---|---|
| Class | `McoreServices\TeamleaderSDK\Resources\Other\CloudPlatforms` |
| Create / update / delete | — / — / — |
| Pagination | No |

## Endpoints

- `cloudPlatforms.url`

## Filters

`list()` takes no filters.

## Accepted values

Public constants on the class. Body fields and enum values outside these lists
throw before the request is sent.

| Constant | Values |
|---|---|
| `TYPES` | `deal`, `invoice`, `quotation`, `ticket` |

## Methods

### `url()`

```php

```

Fetch cloud platform URL for a specific resource type and ID

- `$type` — Resource type (invoice, quotation, or ticket)
- `$id` — Resource UUID

**Throws** `InvalidArgumentException`

## Examples

Get cloud platform URL for an invoice:

```php
$result = Teamleader::cloudPlatforms()->url("invoice", "invoice-uuid");
$url = $result["data"]["url"];
```

Get cloud platform URL for a quotation:

```php
$result = Teamleader::cloudPlatforms()->url("quotation", "quotation-uuid");
$url = $result["data"]["url"];
```

Get cloud platform URL for a ticket:

```php
$result = Teamleader::cloudPlatforms()->url("ticket", "ticket-uuid");
$url = $result["data"]["url"];
```

Redirect user to invoice in cloud platform:

```php
$result = Teamleader::cloudPlatforms()->url("invoice", $invoiceId);
return redirect($result["data"]["url"]);
```

Get cloud platform URLs for multiple resources:

```php
$invoiceIds = ["uuid1", "uuid2", "uuid3"];
$urls = [];

foreach ($invoiceIds as $id) {
    $result = Teamleader::cloudPlatforms()->url("invoice", $id);
    $urls[$id] = $result["data"]["url"];
}
```
